view: Gaur Bara Sona Mosque Baroduari ruins at Indian Gaur, diagonal interior view through repeated heavy pointed stone arches and roofless prayer hall, dark grey stone with moss and grass, some broken masonry, Bengal vegetation, no golden domes or intact complete roof.

eras.title: Through the mosque's arches
eras.caption: At Gaur, the Bara Sona Mosque survives as a roofless series of stone-faced arches. Its remains belong to a capital of the Bengal sultans, where large religious buildings rose beside a dense urban settlement.
